About SideTippers Australia:

SideTippers Australia is a leading Australian manufacturer of premium side tippers and heavy transport equipment, supplying innovative solutions to the mining, agricultural, civil construction and transport industries. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality workmanship, reliable products and exceptional customer service. Due to continued growth, we are seeking a skilled and motivated Welder (First Class) to join our manufacturing team in Chadwick, Western Australia.

Responsibilities:

The Welder (First Class) is responsible for the fabrication, assembly, repair and maintenance of heavy transport equipment and fabricated steel components, ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with engineering specifications, Australian Standards and company quality requirements.

Tasks:

•	Bring equipment, trailers and components into the workshop for fabrication, modification or repair.
•	Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, specifications and cut lists to determine fabrication requirements.
•	Assess fabrication and repair work and plan welding and fabrication projects accurately to ensure efficient production outcomes.
•	Prepare, measure, cut, shape and align metal sections using hand tools, grinders, flame-cutting equipment and fabrication machinery.
•	Perform MIG, TIG and arc welding to manufacture, assemble, repair and modify trailers, heavy transport equipment and structural steel components.
•	Join metal sections using welding, bolting and riveting techniques where required.
•	Inspect completed welds to ensure quality, strength, penetration and compliance with engineering specifications.
•	Finish fabricated products by grinding, cleaning and polishing to achieve a high-quality finish.
•	Operate workshop equipment safely and maintain tools, machinery and equipment in good working order.
•	Work collaboratively with the workshop team to meet production schedules while maintaining a clean, organised and safe work environment.
•	Comply with all workplace health and safety procedures, company policies and quality standards.

Qualifications:

•	Trade qualification as a Welder (First Class), Engineering Tradesperson (Fabrication), or equivalent recognised qualification.
•	Current driver's licence is desirable.

Skills:

•	Proficiency in MIG, TIG and arc welding techniques.
•	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints and technical specifications.
•	Strong fabrication, metalworking and problem-solving skills.
•	High attention to detail with a commitment to producing quality workmanship.
•	Strong organisational skills with the ability to plan and prioritise fabrication tasks effectively.
•	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
•	Strong commitment to workplace health and safety and safe work practices.

Experience:

•	Minimum 2 years' post-trade experience as a Welder (First Class) or in a similar fabrication role.
•	Experience manufacturing, repairing and modifying heavy machinery, trailers, transport equipment or structural steel.
•	Proven ability to work from engineering drawings and cut lists to produce accurate, high-quality fabrication work.
•	Experience operating workshop fabrication equipment and working in a heavy engineering or manufacturing environment.
•	Demonstrated ability to consistently deliver quality work while meeting production deadlines and company standards.

Job Description:
AI Talent is seeking a skilled and motivated Web Developer to join our team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for developing and maintaining high-performing websites and web applications that provide outstanding user experiences. Collaborating with clients and internal stakeholders, you’ll turn project objectives into intuitive, effective digital solutions. This role demands a blend of technical expertise, creativity, and a hands-on problem-solving mindset.
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to gather requirements and understand project objectives
Design and develop responsive websites and web applications using modern web technologies
Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other relevant programming languages
Conduct thorough testing and debugging of web applications to ensure functionality and optimise performance
Implement security measures and best practices to protect websites and user data
Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies, and propose innovative solutions to enhance web development processes
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers and back-end developers, to deliver seamless user experiences
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues that arise during the development process
Provide technical guidance and support to junior team members when needed
Qualifications and Skills:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
Must have at least 2 years of proven experience as a Web Developer, with a strong portfolio showcasing your web development projects
Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other relevant web technologies
Experience with front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and web development tools
Strong understanding of responsive design principles and mobile-first development
Knowledge of SEO best practices and web accessibility standards
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment
Strong communication skills to effectively interact with clients and team members
Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Type: Full-time
Job Types: Permanent, Full-time
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
Benefits: Work from home
Schedule: 8-hour shift
Work Authorisation: Australia (Required)

result.description:
FULL TIME 38 HOURS PER WEEK

MINIMUM 4 WEEKS ANNUAL LEAVE

SALARY PLUS SUPER

$75K PA - $85K PA plus super

BOZMAC PTY LTD, also known as Bozmac Towing Equipment, is looking for a Metal Fabricator to support their operations.

Bozmac is an Australian-owned manufacturer specializing in high-performance towing and recovery equipment, including tilt slide bodies, truck packages, rotators, and towing accessories designed for professional operators across Australia and the South Pacific. Known as the “Tilt Slide Specialists,” the company combines industry experience, innovative engineering, and rigorous testing to deliver durable, reliable, and safe towing solutions built for demanding recovery operations. Based in Hervey Bay, Queensland, Bozmac is recognized for producing functional, heavy-duty equipment backed by quality craftsmanship and a strong reputation within the towing industry. 

To be considered for the role, you need to have a relevant industry qualification or at least 1-2 years' experience in a similar position.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

-Interpret engineering drawings, fabrication plans and technical specifications to determine manufacturing requirements.
-Select, measure, prepare and mark out steel, aluminium and other metal materials for fabrication.
-Cut, shape, bend and form metal sections using hand tools, power tools and fabrication machinery.
-Fabricate structural components, truck bodies, chassis modifications and towing equipment in accordance with engineering specifications.
-Align, fit and assemble fabricated components using precision measuring instruments and fabrication techniques.
-Join metal components using MIG, TIG and other appropriate welding processes, together with bolting and riveting where required.
-Inspect fabricated components and welded assemblies to ensure dimensional accuracy, weld quality and compliance with engineering specifications.
-Grind, finish, clean and prepare fabricated products for painting, assembly and final installation.
-Operate fabrication equipment safely while maintaining a clean and organised work environment.
-Work collaboratively with the team, supervisors and production staff to ensure 
-Manufacturing deadlines and quality standards are achieved.

If you are a motivated Metal Fabricator with a strong commitment to quality workmanship and manufacturing excellence, we encourage you to apply and become part of the Bozmac team.
